name: NameGenerator
src_typeComment: Markov-chain name generator: trains a chain of character n-grams from a list of sample names, then generates new names by sampling that chain — new names "sound like" the training set without ever being an exact copy of one. A built-in fantasy-name corpus is provided so this works with zero setup; assign your own trainingNames for a different flavor (sci-fi, real-world, item names, etc.). Plain [Serializable] class (not a MonoBehaviour) so it can be embedded as a field on whatever component needs it, the same way Toolkit.MathUtilities.PityTimer is used.

src_serialized.name: trainingNames
src_serialized.tooltip: Sample names the Markov chain learns from. Longer/more varied lists produce more varied output. Leave empty to use the built-in fantasy-name corpus.

src_serialized.name: order
src_serialized.tooltip: How many preceding characters predict the next one. 2 = fairly random/varied, 3 = closer to the training names, 4+ risks reproducing them almost verbatim.

src_serialized.name: minLength
src_serialized.tooltip: Generated names outside this length range are discarded and re-rolled (up to a retry limit).

src_members.name: GenerateName
src_members.comment: Pass your own System.Random for reproducible output (e.g. from a level seed); omit it for a different result each call.
